description:
Moving to New York from Japan in 2006, Haruka has become one of Brooklyn’s most versatile, seasoned, and in-demand DJs, joining the dots between house, techno, electro, hip hop, disco, rock, and more. For more than 15 years she has continuously been on the cutting edge, and in recent years she’s been making regular appearances at the likes of Bossa Nova, Elsewhere and Mood Ring, including infamous sets at the influential BOUND and Fourth World parties. Joining toucan sounds, and teaming up with a 'who's who' of underground dance artists, ‘HarukaMart’ is the debut EP under her disco/house-leaning project Haruka Salt.


Follow Haruka Salt :: https://linktr.ee/harukanyc999
Follow toucan sounds :: https://www.toucansounds.com
